data.question_quote: The first one - I noticed that your cost guidance is based on an average Page 10 of 13 exchange rate in Q1, but the US dollar is off 6% since then, so I assume that if we were to actually do that at today's exchange rate, your cost number would be somewhat higher than that. I'm just trying to check - is your revenue guidance also based on those exchange rates?
